understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to step onto and complete all goal cells. A goal only completes when the carried piece matches the goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the moment you enter that cell; completing every goal advances to the next level, and winning requires clearing all levels before running out of lives/turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen. Modifier tiles change the carried piece when stepped on: shape changers cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrap), color changers cycle colors in order orange → blue → green → red → orange (wrap), and rotation changers rotate 90° clockwise through 0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0° (wrap). A goal activates and can be completed only when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously upon stepping onto it; route planning is important to avoid wasted moves and stamina.
